title: Quiz: Break and Continue
description: Check your understanding of Break and Continue.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Python?
questions.explanation: In Python, # marks a comment. Block comments use # (line comments only).

questions.question: What does "continue" do inside a loop?
questions.explanation: Continue abandons the current iteration only.

questions.question: True or False: "break" inside a nested loop exits only the innermost loop in most languages.
Fill in the blank: if done { $break }   // exit loop now
In Python, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
